result.title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
result.comment: Guo Chen, Fuxiao Liu, Haoqin Tu, and Yiyang Zhou contributed equally and are listed alphabetically by surname. Project lead: Guilin Liu
result.summary: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB over Emu3.5 IBQ. It also provides 7.13x faster encoding and 10.93x faster decoding at batch size one on A100. In standalone evaluation, one Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode variant surpasses Kimi K3.1 Pro on the aggregate across Chart2Code, MMSVG, Design2Code, and Image2Struct. At the system level, the Nemotron-native configuration raises GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56 using the same raster generator. With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「Pixel as Code」的 agentic 视觉创作框架：用学习到的离散视觉 token 表示栅格图像、用显式程序表示结构化产物，并通过共享的生成—渲染接口统一图像、矢量图、网页与文档，同时配套图像 tokenizer、自回归图像生成器和视觉代码模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其离散视觉 token 表示与依据视觉反馈进行栅格候选选择、定向修复的闭环，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据保留、候选验证与停止决策提供可供核查的线索，但论文本身面向创作与重建任务，未研究推理期 latent 状态。
